sv.title: Kolonistuga i lågor utanför Trelleborg
sv.summary: Under natten mot lördag kom larmet. Ett kolonistuga hade fattat eld i Trelleborgs östra utkanter.

en.title: Allotment cabin ablaze outside Trelleborg
en.summary: The alarm came during the night towards Saturday. A allotment cabin had caught fire on the eastern outskirts of Trelleborg.
